### Item 1 — user expression and simulator behaviour

- Target: the 12-month CD ending 4092 (when asked), which "just matured and is going to roll over"; source: money market ending 5174.
- Action boundary: "put in just enough from your money market for the CD to get the jumbo rate when it renews — not a penny more than it needs"; "That is all you called about." Authorisation: "The bank can handle its own side however it has to"; the customer runs the transfer once told the amount.
- Timing: now (2026-09-17 14:05 EDT); renewal is future.
- Conditional disclosures: the 6000 withdrawal on the 14th to Interest Checking (only if raised); Everyday Checking closed in August, everything goes to Interest Checking 4861 (only if raised); interest should be paid to that Interest Checking (only if asked); keep renewing as 12-month (only if asked); accepts a credited-back charge and any top-up amount that comes from the money market. Executes the handed-over deposit tool exactly. Never volunteers the penalty or the closed account.

### Item 2 — act now / wait / refuse, and eligibility grounds

Act now, with three writes (two agent, one user); the renewal itself is NOT booked now.
- Grace still running: maturity 2026-09-10, grace 10 days -> through 2026-09-20; today is day 7 ("maturity_notice_and_grace_actions" window).
- Jumbo top-up available ("jumbo_top_up_applicability"): status grace period; 7 <= 10 days; instruction automatic renewal; renewal tier of the 12-Month is the 12-Month ("term_and_renewal_settings_by_tier"); 12-Month offers the jumbo bonus (0.10, threshold 100000.00) and allows grace add-ons ("grace_period_allowances": smallest 100.00, total 250000.00).
- Renewal not yet due: "more than the tier's grace period length ... has passed" fails (7 is not more than 10) ("renewal_timing_after_grace"); "When the renewal has not yet fallen to be booked ... no renewal is written" ("renewal_rate_composition" rule 5).
- Two blocking conditions exist on the top-up (Item 6) and each has an action that clears it today.

### Item 4 — scored parameters

A. Grace penalty reversal
- Posted 2026-09-14 = day 4 after maturity 2026-09-10, inside day 1..10 -> "taken during the grace period" ("grace_timing_of_penalized_withdrawal"; recorded kind early_partial does not matter: "whatever withdrawal kind the entry was recorded under").
- Owner's own: destination checking, counterparty `d9c9a0f9` belongs to the owner ("owners_own_grace_withdrawal_test").
- Not already reversed. -> reverse in full, booked amount to the cent ("grace_penalty_reversal_decision").
- Wrong-rate path excluded: "A penalty whose posted date falls on day 1 through the last day of the tier's grace period ... is outside the wrong-rate and wrong-days check" ("grace_dated_penalty_exclusion").
- **reverse_grace_penalty_e6d62385{certificate c5949fbf, source_item_id dd1f009a, amount 58.73}.**

B. Interest payout repointing
- Disposition pay to checking; named checking `06e08f86` status closed -> payout account closed ("closed_interest_payout_account_test").
- Maturity instruction is automatic renewal, not a payout on the same account -> repointing applies ("maturity_payout_on_same_closed_account" table row "Automatic renewal: Yes").
- Replacement: "the owner's active account of the same kind" -> active checking `d9c9a0f9`; disposition stays pay to checking ("replacement_interest_payout_account" rule 1; "interest_repoint_outcome" rule 1); 12-Month lists pay to checking ("interest_crediting_and_payout_options").
- **update_interest_disposition_67b383bc{certificate c5949fbf, interest_disposition pay_to_checking, payout_account_id d9c9a0f9}.**
- Maturity instruction left as is: auto renewal -> "Not concerned" ("payout_account_closure_test"; "maturity_instruction_replacement_outcome" rule 4).

C. Jumbo top-up size
- Reconciled principal after A ("grace_principal_reconciliation"): 99850.00 + 435.34 + 58.73 - 6000.00 - 58.73 = **94285.34** (94226.61 before the reversal = record balance).
- Shortfall = 100000.00 - 94285.34 = **5714.66** (rounded half up); >= smallest grace add-on 100.00 -> top-up = 5714.66 ("jumbo_shortfall_top_up_size").
- Room under grace total: 250000.00 - 0.00 = 250000.00 >= 5714.66; source balance 7420.66 >= 5714.66 ("grace_cap_and_source_balance_room"); principal 94285.34 < threshold -> written at size ("jumbo_top_up_write_rule").
- Concentration cap: 94285.34 + 5714.66 = 100000.00 <= 2500000.00 ("customer_concentration_cap"). Tier maximum principal 1000000.00 not reached.
- **add_grace_deposit_522b16cc{customer cb678343, certificate c5949fbf, amount 5714.66, funding_source pcb_savings, counterparty_account_id ab16c4dd}**, run by the customer.

2. agent: find_cd_certificates, find_cd_transactions, find_checking_accounts, find_savings_accounts.

### Item 6 — problem tree from the visible documents alone

Root R: "just enough from the money market for the jumbo rate at renewal" = grace-period jumbo top-up.
- R needs: owed penalty reversals already posted ("grace_principal_reconciliation": "Condition before the jumbo top-up is measured: Any penalty reversal owed on the certificate is already in its ledger when the jumbo shortfall is measured. Where that condition does not hold, the top-up is not measured."; rule 3). Query: penalty dd1f009a posted in grace, owner's own, unreversed -> a reversal is owed -> **fails**. Clearing action: P1 = reverse_grace_penalty_e6d62385 58.73 ("grace_withdrawal_penalty_reversal_34a9729b" + "grace_penalty_reversal_decision"). No further unmet condition.
- R needs: the payout disposition names an open account ("open_payout_account_for_grace_money": "Condition before new grace money is added: The certificate's payout disposition names an open account of the owner before new grace money is added"; rule 3 "While the disposition pays to a closed payout account, no top-up is written"). Query: pay_to_checking to closed `06e08f86` -> **fails**. Clearing action: P2 = interest repointing to the owner's active checking via update_interest_disposition_67b383bc ("interest_payout_account_repoint", "replacement_interest_payout_account", "interest_repoint_outcome"). P2's own conditions: not excluded by a same-account maturity payout (auto renewal), tier lists pay to checking -> holds.
- Dependency direction: P1 -> R, P2 -> R. Order: {P1, P2} (either order) -> R.
- Non-edges checked: maturity instruction already auto renewal (no replacement); renewal not due; applicability conditions of R hold; source balance and grace cap sufficient.
- No visible document aggregates this chain into a route for this situation (the only SOP document concerns the post-grace renewal + in-term add-on case, which is not this one).

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the top-up" (5773.39 = 100000 - 94226.61, on the unreconciled/unreversed principal, straight away): excluded by the two conditions quoted in Item 6; the "grace_principal_reconciliation" example ("the gap to the jumbo threshold is 120.00 smaller") shows the direction.
- "Reverse with reverse_penalty_error_2ccc5de3 / check the rate": excluded by "grace_dated_penalty_exclusion".
- "Refuse the reversal because the entry says early_partial": excluded by "grace_timing_of_penalized_withdrawal" point of judgement.
- "Repoint to the money market and make it compound": excluded by "replacement_interest_payout_account" rule 1 (same kind first; an active checking exists).
- "Replace the maturity instruction too": excluded — auto renewal is "Not concerned"/"left as they are".
- "Book the renewal now with jumbo": excluded by "renewal_timing_after_grace" (7 is not more than 10) and "renewal_rate_composition" rule 5.
- "Use add_term_deposit (in-term add-on)": excluded — 12-Month allows 0 in-term add-ons and status is not Active ("in_term_add_on_limits", "certificate_standing_for_in_term_add_on").
- "Round the top-up to 5800 / 5714.66 not enough": excluded by "never cut down" and "equals the Shortfall"; customer asked for "not a penny more".

### Residual visibility notes (blind)

- "open_payout_account_for_grace_money" and "grace_principal_reconciliation" each phrase their gate as a "Condition before ..." section; both are strength "not measured / not accepted" (hard gates), consistent with each other.
- The retired grace-add-on clause in "maturity_notice_and_grace_actions" says it is "superseded by the current basis for grace add-ons" without naming the document; the current basis is findable ("open_payout_account_for_grace_money" rule 1 restates the grace add-on allowance with the closed-account condition).

### Blind conclusion

Unique visible solution: grace penalty reversal 58.73 on dd1f009a; interest repointed to pay_to_checking / Interest Checking d9c9a0f9; user grace add-on 5714.66 pcb_savings from ab16c4dd; no renewal, no instruction change.
